elements.name: Dock a floating panel to an edge with a visible target preview

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is floating over the workspace
the user drags the panel title bar toward the left workspace edge
the left docking target is indicated before the panel is released
the user releases the panel over that target
the panel docks along the left edge of the workspace
the viewport resizes to occupy the remaining workspace
the active part remains visible

elements.name: Dock a panel to each supported workspace edge

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is floating over the workspace
the user docks the panel to the right workspace edge
the panel is attached along the right edge
the viewport occupies the workspace to its left
the user docks the panel to the top workspace edge
the panel is attached below the ribbon
the viewport occupies the workspace below the panel
the user docks the panel to the bottom workspace edge
the panel is attached above the document tabs and status area
the viewport occupies the workspace above the panel

elements.name: Resize a docked panel from its shared boundary

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport
the user drags the panel boundary away from the viewport
the panel becomes wider
the viewport becomes narrower by the corresponding amount
the panel contents and active part remain visible
the user drags the boundary back
the panel and viewport return to their previous proportions

elements.name: Join panels in one dock region as selectable tabs

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
two dockable panels are open in separate workspace regions
the user drags one panel onto the center of the other panel's dock region
the destination region indicates a tab insertion target
the user releases the panel over that target
both panels occupy the same dock region as tabs
one panel is active while the other remains available
the user selects the other panel tab
its contents replace the active panel contents in that region
the viewport and active document remain available

elements.name: Float a docked panel and dock it again

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is docked beside the viewport
the user drags its title bar away from the dock targets
the panel floats above the workspace
the viewport expands into the space released by the panel
the user drags the floating panel to a workspace dock target
the panel docks at that target
the viewport adjusts to the resulting workspace layout

elements.name: Close a docked panel and restore it from the interface menu

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel is the active tab in a dock region
the user closes the panel
the panel is removed from the visible workspace
the remaining dock regions and viewport use the freed space
the user opens the interface visibility menu
the user selects the closed panel
the panel is restored to the workspace
its contents are visible

elements.name: Retain a panel layout while switching active documents

steps.name: two documents are open in the MCAD Software
a dockable panel has been moved, resized, or tabbed in the workspace
the user switches to the other document
the docked panel arrangement remains in place
the active document changes in the viewport
the user returns to the first document
the panel arrangement remains available

elements.name: Restore the saved panel arrangement after restarting the application

steps.name: the user has changed the workspace panel arrangement
the MCAD Software has saved that arrangement
the user closes and restarts the MCAD Software
the saved panel positions, sizes and tab groups are restored
